terra.problem: Miriam’s relationship to Moses and Aaron is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference, such as Numbers 26:59.
The text says the congregation gathered against Moses and Aaron and quarreled, but it does not say that nobody was praying.
The people complain about where they are, but the text does not say how they feel about the view ahead.
The text says the congregation and livestock were able to drink; it does not say that they drank.
The text does not mention enemies, but it does not say there were none in sight.
Verse 13 names the waters of Meribah, not the place itself.
